top_posts.text: Data centers need power — is Southern Company the boring AI play?    Everyone's chasing the AI winners — the chipmakers, the model builders. I've been thinking about the other end: somebody has to power all of it.   Southern Company ($SO) keeps coming up for me:  • Georgia Power is right in the middle of data-center buildout country  • Every new data center is basically a new giant power customer
